target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Primary event venue in Ashtabula County with extensive facilities: Expo Center (4-H Building) for 450 people, Commercial Building for auctions, Pavilion for outdoor events, horse arenas, livestock barns, and camping. Hosts festivals, weddings, trade shows, horse shows, livestock auctions. Current process requires manual calls/emails for booking - perfect for digital permit/intake system.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Manages parks and building rentals in the Village of Jefferson (Ashtabula County seat). Offers fitness center, park rentals, and event facilities. Serves as municipal hub for community events and recreation programming. Would benefit from streamlined event permit system for park usage and facility rentals.
